name: J. W. Reynolds
bio: J. W. Reynolds was the Cow Boy's printer and signed the Republican convention call of April 1884. He left for the East in May 1884 with the editor's praise.

moments.label: Left Medora; praised as a top Dakota printer

mentions: …T. J. Kerr, Geo. Blankenberg, A. T. Packard, Gill Kennedy, E. G. Paddock, G. W. Fitzgerald, W. F. Houk, J. W. Reynolds, Max Bass, Wm. Van Driesche, Frank Keeler.
…T. J. KERR, GEO. BLANKENBERG, A. T. PACKARD, GILL KENNEDY, E. G. PADDOCK, G. W. FITZGERALD, W. F. HOUK, J. W. REYNOLDS, MAX BASS, WM. VAN DRIESCHE, FRANK KEELER.
J. W. Reynolds, our printer, left Sunday morning for the east. Whoever employs him may be sure of getting as good a printer as there is in Dakota.
